After: the juice glass has a small residue, the bowl is empty, the banana is eaten (peel left), a few egg yolk crumbs remain, toast gone, and the mug looks empty.

Eaten: juice ~170 g (75 kcal), tea/coffee ~200 g (2 kcal; the mug looks empty, so it was probably drunk), strawberries 60 g (19 kcal), banana 118 g (105 kcal), toast 60 g (150 kcal), eggs ~85 g (165 kcal).

Total kcal ≈ 75+2+19+105+150+165 = 516. Mass ≈ 170+200+60+118+60+85 = 693 g.
